title: AMP Entry
description: A single AI Memory Protocol entry (one line in sessions.jsonl)

type.description: The semantic type of this memory entry

ts.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this entry was created

id.description: Unique entry ID (ULID format with amp_ prefix)

file.description: Relative file path from workspace root

function.description: Function or method name where this applies

tags.description: Freeform tags for grouping and search

source.description: Tool or method that created this entry (e.g., 'vscode-extension', 'cli', 'git-hook')

tool.description: Which AI tool was active when this was logged

confidence.description: Confidence score for auto-captured entries (0 = uncertain, 1 = certain)
